name: floating-points-club
north_star: Adam's Floating Points: tight 129-136 BPM flat-minor CLUB cuts with a pedal-tone hammer (one note repeated obsessively, broken by octave/P5 leaps) — not wandering ambient
reference: Floating Points · LesAlpx / Key103 (F min / 129-136 BPM, pedal-tone melody, patient builds, extreme dynamics)
caption: An energetic and driving tech-house track built on a foundation of a punchy four-on-the-floor drum machine beat and a rolling, hypnotic synth bassline. The melodic core is a single pedal-tone note from an analog modular synthesizer, repeated obsessively and broken by occasional octave leaps, its pitch drifting subtly with each repetition. The arrangement progressively layers rhythmic synth stabs and atmospheric pads that build tension. A breakdown strips away the beat to reveal atmospheric textures and a lone sub tone, before slamming back into the full groove with euphoric intensity.
caption_note: edited from acestep-captioner prose on LesAlpx (datasets/handpicked/floating-points-06-lesalpx.acecaption.txt) — kept the pedal-tone-hammer north star inside the captioner's tech-house dialect
script:
[Intro - quiet modular pulse from silence]
[Build - percussion layers fold in]
[Drop - full club groove, pedal-tone hammer]
[Verse - filters drift and churn]
[Breakdown - sudden silence, lone sub tone]
[Build - tension claws back]
[Drop - euphoric peak]
[Outro - elements strip away]
